copied_reference.behavioral_reference: network-realy-nf/App/Sources; reimplemented in Rust, not linked or loaded
copied_reference.adaptation_status: This commit identifies the copied baseline. RS protocol, lifecycle and transport repairs are independent adaptations; copied source is not claimed to remain byte-identical to NF.

production_transport: Tokio sockets and DNS, rustls TLS, Quinn QUIC, Rust HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3
native_ui: Rust AppKit/Objective-C ABI adapter; no Swift or Network.framework
independence: Copied protocol sources and vendored libraries live below this directory. Build and runtime never require sibling application source. No existing project code is changed for this app.
build_identity: The binary and bundle record APP_BUILD_TIME and APP_SOURCE_REVISION; uncommitted application changes append -dirty.
